title: Customer Frustration & Escalation Risk
description: Customer expresses rising annoyance over repetitive questions and system delays.

chunks.speaker: Agent
chunks.text: Can you please verify your policy number and date of birth once more?

chunks.speaker: Customer
chunks.text: I already told you twice! Why does your system keep asking me? This is ridiculous and a complete waste of time!

chunks.speaker: Agent
chunks.text: I apologize, let me check the database...
